title: Add tests that fail when a sensitive field or tool argument loses its classification annotation
description: db-models (ciSystem none): add tests/test_data_classification.py. It imports onfinance_db_model_master.models, loads the field map from docs/data-classification.md (or a checked-in JSON copy of it) and asserts that every mapped field has a data_classification attribute equal to the approved labels. Document running pytest before tagging a release in the README. mongodb-mcp-server (GitHub Actions): add tests/unit/tools/mongodb/dataClassification.test.ts, which builds the tool registry, serialises each mongodb/* tool input schema to JSON Schema and asserts x-data-classification is present on every client-data argument, so the existing pnpm test job in CI enforces it. Neither test touches a database or a deployed environment.
acceptanceCriteria: pytest tests/test_data_classification.py passes on the db-models PR branch and fails when the data_classification kwarg is removed from User.user_email

pnpm vitest run tests/unit/tools/mongodb/dataClassification.test.ts passes on mongodb-mcp-server and fails when withClassification is removed from zEJSON; the GitHub Actions test job on the PR shows the new test executed

verificationMethod.description: A reviewer checks out each PR, runs both test commands (expected: pass), deletes one annotation in each repo, re-runs them (expected: fail naming the unannotated field or argument), then restores the annotation. The GitHub Actions run URL for mongodb-mcp-server is attached as evidence.

rootCause.description: No automated check tied the code to the approved classification, so new or renamed fields could silently lose annotations and reopen SCH-PII-01 or SCH-PII-06.
